message.content:
Below is a **country‑wide (federal) list of long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
These are the public holidays that either fall on a Friday or a Monday (or are observed on the following Monday when they land on a weekend), giving you a 3‑day weekend.  

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday; the federal holiday is observed on Monday, so the weekend is extended. |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat Feb 18‑Mon Feb 20). |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday holiday → long weekend (Fri Apr 7‑Sun Apr 9). |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat May 20‑Mon May 22). |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day falls on Saturday; the federal holiday is observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat Sep 2‑Mon Sep 4). |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday holiday → long weekend (Sat Oct 7‑Mon Oct 9). |
| **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday; the federal holiday is observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 25 – Dec 27** | Christmas (observed Mon Dec 26) | Christmas falls on Monday; the federal holiday is observed on Monday, so the weekend is extended (Sat Dec 23‑Mon Dec 25). |

### Quick Summary (Dates of the long weekends)

| Long Weekend | Dates | Holiday |
|--------------|-------|---------|
| New Year’s | Jan 1‑3 | New Year’s Day |
| Family Day | Feb 20 | Family Day (some provinces) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7‑9 | Good Friday |
| Victoria Day | May 20‑22 | Victoria Day |
| Canada Day | Jul 1‑3 | Canada Day |
| Labour Day | Sep 2‑4 | Labour Day |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 7‑9 | Thanksgiving |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11‑13 | Remembrance Day |
| Christmas | Dec 23‑25 | Christmas |

> **Pro‑Tip:**  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, add its own holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) – many of those also create long weekends.  
> • For federal‑government employees, the “observed” dates above are the official holiday dates. Private‑sector employers may follow the same pattern or their own local rules.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
